title: Terrace-slab crack — measured vs guessed
sub: Terrace slab · Nov 2026 · Ref SC-25D35C5E · 2 INR coin (25 mm) for scale

method: Outlines measured from photo pixels, scaled by the coin diameter (tilt-corrected from its ellipse). Scale: 2 INR coin, typed 25 mm — the same coin ruler-reads 24 mm, and at 24 mm the length reads 228.0 mm. Truth is the thread path, 238.8 mm ±4 mm. Every number cites its evidence receipt.
verification: Evidence gate: passed · Independent skeptic: live gate pass, nothing disputed (2026-11-03) · Mask cross-check: not run (no masks archived)
outcome: The photo measurement landed 1.3 mm off the thread truth; the photo-alone guess did not land inside ±10%. Bench case terrace-slab-tape-01.
